automationNotes: Doc: [Delete an Audience](https://www.contentstack.com/docs/personalize/delete-audience) — **Delete a Non-Referenced Audience** only (no Experiences prerequisite). Destructive. Set **`PERSONALIZE_DELETE_AUDIENCE_ROW_CONTAINS`** (default **`AUTO Audience`**) on a disposable row. **`stage: delete`** runs after `main`.
